meta.description: Grows an umbel at the tip of every path: rays that spread from one point, like the flower heads of wild carrot, fennel or elder. Gives the rays and their tips as points, where instance_from_points places the flowers.

plant.description: The paths to put the umbels on, at their tips.

amount.description: How many rays every umbel and umbellet has.

length.description: The length of the outer rays.

length_variation.description: How much shorter a ray can randomly be. 0 = all as the shape says, 1 = down to nothing.

opening.description: The angle between the axis and the outer rays, in degrees.

shape.description: Where the tips lie. 0 = on a flat top, the inner rays are shorter, 1 = on a dome, all rays are as long, negative = in a cup.

depth.description: 1 = a simple umbel, 2 = a compound umbel with an umbellet on every ray.

umbellet_scale.description: The size of an umbellet relative to the umbel it grows on, for the length and the thickness of its rays.

layers.description: On how many of the deepest layers of paths to put umbels.

resolution_curve.description: The resolution of a ray as long as the longest path, shorter rays get fewer points.
